canonical_question: Does the 'Cr ~40 at%' iso-concentration surface shown in the inset of Fig 7(c) accurately capture the full volume of the gen-2 BCC precipitate or just its boundary?

question_variants.question: Does the 'Cr ~40 at%' iso-concentration surface shown in the inset of Fig 7(c) accurately capture the full volume of the gen-2 BCC precipitate or just its boundary?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The iso-concentration surface clearly delineates the gen-2 BCC precipitate, implying it captures the boundary or surface definition of the phase rather than the full internal volume.

answers.answer: The Cr ~40 at% iso-concentration surface clearly delineates the gen-2 BCC precipitate. This implies it defines the boundary or interface of the phase.
answers.measurement_outcome: Clearly delineates the gen-2 BCC precipitate
evidence_spans: Additionally, it is shown that replacement of Co by Cr in the AlCoFeNi alloy resulted in a substantial reduction in saturation magnetization and increase in coercivity.
The microhardness is also strongly influenced by the composition and the length scale of B2 + BCC decomposition in these high entropy alloys.
